title: Bigfoot rumours in D sector
place_text: D sector, Vandenberg Air Force Base, California

tellings.quote: to scare the new guys was Bigfoot's out there and he's he's going to get you, but there was nothing about UFOs or even talk about it that I know.

plain: A former nuclear missile guard named Richard Barth says that in 1964, in D sector at Vandenberg Air Force Base in California, the guards scared new recruits with stories of Bigfoot, but no one talked about UFOs. Barth tells Michels he served there himself: the joke was that "Bigfoot's out there and he's going to get you, but there was nothing about UFOs or even talk about it that I know." His point is that UFOs were not on anyone's mind before what he says happened to him later.
